headline: About RunMyCampus.
subheadline: One platform for global school operations, built for 195 countries.

segments.title: Mission
segments.body: Empower every school with unified operations, compliance, and growth tools.

segments.title: Global reach
segments.body: Multi-language, multi-currency, and data residency options for every region.

segments.title: Security first
segments.body: Schema-per-tenant isolation and audit-ready controls for trust and compliance.

faqs.question: Who is RunMyCampus for?
faqs.answer: K-12 schools, international schools, and multi-campus operators who need one operating system for admissions, academics, finance, and compliance.

faqs.question: Where do you operate?
faqs.answer: The platform is built for global deployment with region-aware compliance defaults.
